about: Fortnite content read at runtime from the player's own Fortnite install (unencrypted files only; never copied). No cinematics are shown (creator request): movies are used for their soundtrack only. The hub plays the mod's own looping track (assets/minebloxroyale/sounds/music/hub_loop.ogg) instead of trailer soundtracks (creator: they sounded odd and had gaps). Paths are relative to {game:fortnite}.
